title: LiteCorps
description: Keep your items after death in vanilla style
body:
# LiteCorps

Save items after death.

## Description
A small mod that saves your items after death as follows: A chest will spawn in your place where you died, from which you can take things. It’s perfect for a vanilla build if you just want a simple way to save your items without using KeepInventory.

No client installation is required; simply install it on the server.

A player who does not own a chest cannot open it.
